target_customer: Restaurant brands using many software tools
problem: Restaurants use dozens of apps and cannot unify data for analytics, marketing and finance.

founders.name: Collin Wallace
founders.background_notes: Head of Innovation at Grubhub; joined Thanx as VP of Insights

founders.name: Ashutosh Joshi
founders.background_notes: Led restaurant-facing engineering at Grubhub; became Thanx director of engineering

technical_complexity.rationale: Many restaurant system integrations and a data warehouse; standard engineering with integration breadth.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations help but data pipes are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Thanx bought the company in April 2022 to add data insights to its loyalty platform; terms undisclosed.

market_need_then: Company claimed typical restaurants use more than two dozen applications.

brand_strength.rationale: Name change without public explanation; no press on the brand itself.

pivots.why: not stated; sources conflict on former product, one aggregator describes Eatgeek as catering booking

outcome_analysis: Two ex-Grubhub founders built a restaurant data integration platform in YC Winter 2019 after a name change from Eatgeek, and Thanx acquired it in April 2022 with undisclosed terms. Founders joined Thanx in senior roles, so it was a team and product acquisition rather than a clear financial outcome.
notes: Funding unverified: Seedtable lists YC seed March 2019 no amount, StartupIntros $150K, CB Insights $450K total; none recorded as rounds. Acquisition date 2022-04-05 per search, CB Insights says Apr 7. Dated competitors not found; aggregator lists are unreliable. Rebrand date and reason unknown. Completeness pass: Seed round rests on Startupintros ($150K, March 2019; Seedtable also dates a YC seed March 2019 without amount). CB Insights reports $450K total over several rounds, so rounds totaling about $300K are not itemized. Acquisition by Thanx on 2022-04-05 confirmed by trade press (terms undisclosed).
